in June 1947, the Sindh University act of 1947 was passed and the university came into being at Karachi which took over the control of Secondary as well as the Higher Secondary education in the province of sindh from the Bombay University.

In the early post-partition period, Karachi remain the seat of capital both of the centre and the province, but then Hyderabad was chosen to serve as seat of Government for the province of sindh and a separate University was planned for Karachi; in consequence of which, the University of sindh at Karachi had to be shifted to Hyderabad.

The Central legislature past one Act in the year 1950; whereby, the University of Karachi was created.

VI of 1972”; whereby, the Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi, was to be bifurcated into two boards viz.

“The Board of the Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education Saddar” And “Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education Nazimabad”.

Ordnance of 1972 was further amended by Amendment Act number 20 of 1973 and Amendment Act number 10 of 1974 of Government of Sindh.

As a result their of the Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi was bifurcated into two boards viz.

“Board of Secondary Education Karachi” and “the Board of Intermediate Education Karachi”.

Thus, the Board of Intermediate Education Karachi was established on 1st February 1974.

Offices of the Board of Secondary Education remained in its old premises where as officers of the Board of Intermediate Education were house in the hostel building and bakhtiar youth centre.

title: Chairman
clean_body_text:
As Chairman, I firmly believe that our commitment to fairness, integrity, and accuracy in the examination process is paramount, as it directly impacts the aspirations and dreams of those who place their trust in our expertise.

We must constantly strive to uphold the highest standards of excellence, ensuring that our examination procedures remain transparent, reliable, and unbiased.

Every decision we make must be grounded in principles of objectivity and inclusivity, respecting the diversity of candidates and their unique talents.

Collaboration and communication are essential cornerstones of success.

let us remain cognizant of the transformative power that education holds.

Through our dedication and commitment to excellence, we have the opportunity to shape individuals who will, in turn, shape the country.

title: Press Release
clean_body_text:
Board of Intermediate Education Karachi On 8 January 1962, the then West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962.

By this ordinance, designation of the President of the Board was changed as Chairman and Higher Secondary Education, previously known as Intermediate Education, was transferred from the University to the Board to implement the recommendations of the commission.

professor Qaiser Hussain Khan Bakhtiari president of the Board of the secondary education was appointed as first Chairman of the board intermediate and secondary education Karachi.

He took over the charge of Higher Secondary Education from Dr.

Ishtiaq Hussain Qureshi, then Vice-Chancellor of the University of Karachi, on 2nd November 1961.

˄ٱ اس ⵇ ẗ 㿏خ ⸗䗂 ㈉ ࡘ اس 䯎 ا䄌وار اور 䑨ان ㈉ د⃝ 㑔ز䂬 䞀۔۹ Ǐ۔ ɝٳ ␰ال ㈉ 㩑 ᠁ 㰖 䞈، ا⑬ ᠁ 䆀 䜱 ᣅاب 㟏۔۱۰ُ ǌ۔ 䁡˄ٱ䣊 ⮪ن ⽮ہ ا㪒ن 䆀 㑔˄ٱ 㿵 䞈۔۱۱ِ اﻣﻴﺪوارن ﻻء ﻫﺪاﻳﺘﻮن ﻛﺎﻏﺬ ﺟﻲ ﭔﻨﻬﻲ ﭘﺎﺳﻦ ﺗﻲ ﻟﮑﻮ ۡﻛﺎﭘﻲ ﺟﻲ اﻧﺪر ﭘﻨﻬﻨﺠﻮ ﻧﺎﻟﻮ، ﺳﻴﭧ ﻧﻤﺒﺮ ﻳﺎ ﻛﻮ ﻧﺸﺎن وﻏﻴﺮه ﻧﻪ ﮀﮇي ڏﻳﻮ، ﭔﻲ ﺻﻮرت ۾ اﻫﻮ ﻏﻴﺮ ﻗﺎﻧﻮﻧﻲ ﻃﺮﻳﻘﻮ اﺳﺘﻌﻤﺎل ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو، ﺟﻨﻬﻦ ﺟﻲ ﺳﺰا ﮔﻬﭧ ۾ ﻛﻨﻬﻦ ﺑﻪ اﻣﻴﺪوار ﮐﻲ ﭘﻴﭙﺮ ورﻫﺎﺋﮡ ﮐﺎن ﭘﻮِء اڌ ﻛﻼڪ ﻳﺎ آﺧﺮي ڏﻫﻦ ﻣﺌﭩﻦ ﺗﺎﺋﻴﻦ ﻛﻤﺮي ﮐﺎن ﭔﺎﻫﺮ رﻫﮡ ﺟﻲ اﺟﺎزت ﻧﺎﻫﻲ اﻣﺘﺤﺎﻧﻲ ﻛﻤﺮي ۾ ﻛﻨﻬﻦ ﺑﻪ ﻗﺴﻢ ﺟﺎ ﻧﻮﭨﺲ، ﻛﺘﺎب ۽ ﻧﻘﺸﺎ وﻏﻴﺮه ﮐﮣﻲ اﭼﮡ ڏوﻫﻪ آﻫﻲ، ان ﮐﻲ ﻛﻤﺮي ﺟﻲ ﭔﺎﻫﺮان ﮀﮇي وﭸﮡ، ﺟﻴﻜﮇﻫﻦ ﻛﻮ اﻣﻴﺪوار اﻧﻬﻦ ﺷﻴﻦ ﮐﺎن ﻣﺪد وﭠﻨﺪو ﻧﻈﺮ اﭼﻲ ﺗﻪ ﻫﻮاﻣﺘﺤﺎن ﻣﺎن ﺧﺎرج ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو، ﺳﺎﮘﻲَء ﻃﺮح ﻛﻮ ﺑﻪ اﻣﻴﺪوار ﺟﻴﻜﻮ ﭘﻴﭙﺮ ۾ ﻛﻨﻬﻦ ﭔﺌﻲ ﺷﺨﺺ ﺟﻲ ﻣﺪد ﻛﻨﺪو ﻳﺎ ان ﮐﺎن ﻣﺪد وﭠﻨﺪو ﻣﻠﻴﻮ، ان ﮐﻲ ڏوﻫﻪ ﺗﺼﻮر ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو ۽ ان اﻣﻴﺪوار ﮐﻲ ﻓﻮري ﻃﻮر ﺧﺎرج ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو اﻣﺘﺤﺂن ﻣﺎن ﺧﺎرج ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو.

␰ال ˄ٱ اس ⵇ ẗ 㿏خ ⸗䗂 ㈉ ࡘ اس 䯎 ا䄌وار اور 䑨ان ㈉ د⃝ 㑔ز䂬 䞀۔۹ Ǐ۔ ɝٳ ␰ال ㈉ 㩑 ᠁ 㰖 䞈، ا⑬ ᠁ 䆀 䜱 ᣅاب 㟏۔۱۰ُ ǌ۔ 䁡˄ٱ䣊 ⮪ن ⽮ہ ا㪒ن 䆀 㑔˄ٱ 㿵 䞈۔۱۱ِ اﻣﻴﺪوارن ﻻء ﻫﺪاﻳﺘﻮن ﻛﺎﻏﺬ ﺟﻲ ﭔﻨﻬﻲ ﭘﺎﺳﻦ ﺗﻲ ﻟﮑﻮ ۡﻛﺎﭘﻲ ﺟﻲ اﻧﺪر ﭘﻨﻬﻨﺠﻮ ﻧﺎﻟﻮ، ﺳﻴﭧ ﻧﻤﺒﺮ ﻳﺎ ﻛﻮ ﻧﺸﺎن وﻏﻴﺮه ﻧﻪ ﮀﮇي ڏﻳﻮ، ﭔﻲ ﺻﻮرت ۾ اﻫﻮ ﻏﻴﺮ ﻗﺎﻧﻮﻧﻲ ﻃﺮﻳﻘﻮ اﺳﺘﻌﻤﺎل ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو، ﺟﻨﻬﻦ ﺟﻲ ﺳﺰا ﮔﻬﭧ ۾ ﻛﻨﻬﻦ ﺑﻪ اﻣﻴﺪوار ﮐﻲ ﭘﻴﭙﺮ ورﻫﺎﺋﮡ ﮐﺎن ﭘﻮِء اڌ ﻛﻼڪ ﻳﺎ آﺧﺮي ڏﻫﻦ ﻣﺌﭩﻦ ﺗﺎﺋﻴﻦ ﻛﻤﺮي ﮐﺎن ﭔﺎﻫﺮ رﻫﮡ ﺟﻲ اﺟﺎزت ﻧﺎﻫﻲ اﻣﺘﺤﺎﻧﻲ ﻛﻤﺮي ۾ ﻛﻨﻬﻦ ﺑﻪ ﻗﺴﻢ ﺟﺎ ﻧﻮﭨﺲ، ﻛﺘﺎب ۽ ﻧﻘﺸﺎ وﻏﻴﺮه ﮐﮣﻲ اﭼﮡ ڏوﻫﻪ آﻫﻲ، ان ﮐﻲ ﻛﻤﺮي ﺟﻲ ﭔﺎﻫﺮان ﮀﮇي وﭸﮡ، ﺟﻴﻜﮇﻫﻦ ﻛﻮ اﻣﻴﺪوار اﻧﻬﻦ ﺷﻴﻦ ﮐﺎن ﻣﺪد وﭠﻨﺪو ﻧﻈﺮ اﭼﻲ ﺗﻪ ﻫﻮاﻣﺘﺤﺎن ﻣﺎن ﺧﺎرج ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو، ﺳﺎﮘﻲَء ﻃﺮح ﻛﻮ ﺑﻪ اﻣﻴﺪوار ﺟﻴﻜﻮ ﭘﻴﭙﺮ ۾ ﻛﻨﻬﻦ ﭔﺌﻲ ﺷﺨﺺ ﺟﻲ ﻣﺪد ﻛﻨﺪو ﻳﺎ ان ﮐﺎن ﻣﺪد وﭠﻨﺪو ﻣﻠﻴﻮ، ان ﮐﻲ ڏوﻫﻪ ﺗﺼﻮر ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو ۽ ان اﻣﻴﺪوار ﮐﻲ ﻓﻮري ﻃﻮر ﺧﺎرج ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو اﻣﺘﺤﺂن ﻣﺎن ﺧﺎرج ﻛﻴﻮ وﻳﻨﺪو.

Candidates are not permitted to leave the examination hall or room until half an hour after the distribution of question papers and 6.

Books, maps, charts, etc., should be left outside the examination hall.

Candidates who are found during the examination to be in possession of books, notes, papers, or scribbling, or who are using or attempting to use unfair means of any kind, shall be expelled from the examination.

A candidate, while under examination, shall not help or try to help any other candidate, nor obtain or try to obtain any help from another candidate.

Communication of any sort or in any form between candidates in the examination hall is strictly forbidden, and any candidates found guilty of this is liable to be expelled instantly.

7.

Smoking is strictly prohibited in the examination hall.

8.

clean_body_text:
Student must signup first with unique ID and then enter in the enrolment system for enrolment process.

Please go through the instruction before proceeding for smooth processing It is to inform that TCS now become our official partner, now all forms of the Board except examination forms shall be submitted along with fee at TCS Outlets or desks.

This facility is available in very economical amount and you dont need to come at BIEK.

I heartily felicitate Prof.

Nasim Ahmed Memon, Chairman BIE Karachi, under whose dynamic and dedicated leadership the Board of Intermediate Education Karachi has made remarkable progress and distinguished itself as an organization excelling in integrity, dexterity and commitment to the cause of promoting merit in the conduct of HSSC Exams.

Well done!

Prof.

Nasim Ahmed Memon!

I wish you Godspeed in al your target-oriented pursuits and lofty goals.
